title: Kissed with Oil Venezuelan Cassaba Empanadas
description: Herbal, chewy, and deliciously quick-fix Venezuelan dish featuring cassaba, infused oil, and a flexitarian twist.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine cassaba, garlic, onion, cilantro, salt, and black pepper.
In a separate bowl, mix together flour and a pinch of salt.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, stirring until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes, cover with plastic wrap, and let rest for 10 minutes.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces, shape each into a ball, and then flatten slightly into disks.
Place a tablespoon of cassaba mixture in the center of each disk, brush edges with water, and fold the dough over to form a half-circle shape.
Press the edges with a fork to seal, and brush tops with infused oil.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat, add a tablespoon of oil, and cook empanadas until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
